article_context: Gallery image supporting the article’s point that buying an apartment while the building is still under construction can be advantageous: the buyer has time to plan the future interior and save for renovation.
image_reading: Low-angle view between two unfinished reinforced-concrete residential towers, with open floor grids and a wide patch of blue sky.
A yellow tower crane spans above the right-hand building; its boom and the thin clouds are the most credible sources of motion.
The exposed concrete structures convey an active, ongoing construction stage.

models.positive_prompt: The tower crane boom makes a slow, controlled sweep over the unfinished towers while thin clouds drift; it settles above the right-hand building in the final frame.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, hold the low-angle architectural view steady as the visible crane boom begins a measured horizontal sweep over the construction site. Let the movement continue smoothly through most of the shot, with only subtle cloud drift as secondary motion. Near the end, the boom eases to a stable position above the right tower, leaving both unfinished buildings continuously clear and recognizable.

models.positive_prompt: A working tower crane slowly pivots across the sky above the unfinished apartment blocks, then comes to rest over the right tower at the end.
models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for one calm construction-site motion: the crane pivots gradually above the exposed apartment frames. Keep the camera fixed on the gap between the towers and retain the same steady pace as the boom travels. It naturally slows and finishes visibly parked over the right-hand structure in the final moments.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed low-angle view: the tower crane pivots steadily over the unfinished residential towers as clouds move lightly, ending with the boom aligned above the right tower.
models.scene_plan: In this focused four-second shot, keep the low-angle camera locked on the two unfinished towers. The crane executes a concise, even pivot across the open sky, supported by slight movement in the thin clouds. The action resolves near the end when the boom is clearly aligned and still above the right tower, preserving the active construction-site meaning.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A home under construction is a tangible future purchase that gives the buyer time to prepare for the move and renovation.
structured_intent.primary_action: The tower crane steadily pivots above the unfinished residential buildings.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The buildings remain visibly unfinished yet actively progressing toward future homes.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The crane boom is visibly settled above the right-hand tower in the final frame.
